text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —I am not an "ordinary princess."

"‘It's here! The feisty Umamusume!!
Who're you calling a princess, feisty!
Feisty!’"

"Hey, look, see? The princess in this picture book is well-behaved, right?
If you want to become a princess, you have to be a quiet, good girl."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm not the "princess" everyone imagines me to be.

"‘A princess unfitting of the historic and dignified
Queen Elizabeth II Cup race itself—’"
"Completely and utterly selfish. The worst princess ever."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It might look that way to some people.
Even so, I—
"'You were a princess,' 'so uniquely you.'"
"She was a 'princess' who was 'uniquely yourself.'"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll be true to myself! A version of me I can be proud of!!
I'm going to become the "Ideal Princess"!!
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Kawakami-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai, you were so cool.
I could feel your passion even while you were running."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I... challenge you again?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes!
Very well, then!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, phew...
My heart is racing and pounding with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A blazing development full of fierce battle after fierce battle.
Is this practically right before the final episode!?
What will be the Princess's next fight!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is already—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —It has to be that race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Kawakami Princess-san!
Your next target is—the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: However, Kawakami Princess, there have been mixed reactions regarding your performance. Especially in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have heard the voices of those
who say I do not act like a queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: However, that is not an issue.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I shall run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup as Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I hold great expectations for the princesses I shall meet there—
the Umamusume striving to discover their steadfast selves."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To all those who pursue their ideals just like me!
Let us compete in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!!
